Collaborating with LTA on a new project that would encourage lapsed tennis players back into the game, remove the elitist identity towards tennis and increase brand engagement.

The update coincides with a rebrand and launch of new products and enhancements. I joined the project to help design the identity for Rally, a website that allows users to book courts and get tips and news around the game.

Logo

Following the vanishing point from the logo mark to define the angle of italics and choosing a face with a taller x-height, making the logo bigger overall, and better for smaller sizes.

Motion

Execution Polygons transform to match the LTA master angles with the animation curves having a longer, shallow finish easing everything to a comfortable stop. Text appears from cuts that match logo angles with the rotation and scaling of graphics gives zooming focus effect.
